# Node reference

**Generated by `scripts/build-node-reference.mjs`. Do not edit — regenerate it.**

Read this before searching the codebase for what a node does. It exists because
that search is expensive and this file is not: the whole catalogue below is under
8,000 characters, and working it out by reading source cost one agent about twenty
tool calls, two of which were the same 1,676-line file.

For the `.cascade` document format, expressions, and how to write a node, see
`AGENTS.md`. **Note in particular that anything time-based is an expression
rather than a node** — `sin($T) * 40` in a parameter — so there is no oscillator
node and none is needed.

## Deterministic nodes, with full declarations

These are definition-v1: their declarations are literal, so what follows is
exact rather than a description.

## Studio node libraries

Class-based nodes, available in Studio. Their parameters are declared in the
class rather than in a literal, so they are listed here by name only — select
one in Studio and read the **Definition** panel for its ports, or open the class
under `src/nodes/<library>/nodes/`.

### Core — `cascade.core.*`

**Routing.** `Switch` (Switch between multiple inputs by index), `Merge` (Combine multiple inputs into an array), `Null` (Pass an input through unchanged)

**Utility.** `Random` (Generate a deterministic value from a seed), `Remap` (Map a number from one range into another), `Select` (Pick an item from an array by index), `Freeze` (Capture and lock a value)

**Network.** `Subnet` (Network container for organizing nodes), `Input` (External input to a subnet), `Output` (Defines subnet output)

### Geometry — `cascade.geo.*`

**Geometry.** `cascade.geo.Rectangle` (A closed four-point polygon, counter-clockwise from bottom-left.), `cascade.geo.Circle` (A closed circle, as one cubic Bezier chain or as a polygon of divisions segments.), `cascade.geo.Transform` (Translate, rotate and scale geometry about a pivot.), `cascade.geo.Merge` (Concatenate geometries, taking the union of their attributes.), `cascade.geo.CopyToPoints` (Instance one geometry onto every point of another.), `cascade.geo.SvgExport` (Write geometry as an SVG document, one group element per group.)

### Image — `cascade.image.*`

**Create.** `Image` (Load images from files), `Color` (Create a solid color canvas), `Checkers` (Generate a checkerboard pattern), `Noise` (Generate procedural noise patterns), `Ramp` (Generate color ramps), `Text` (Render text with customizable font and style)

**Filter.** `Blur` (Gaussian blur), `NormalMap` (Compute normal map from height map)

**Transform.** `Transform` (2D rotation, translation, and scaling), `Resize` (Scale or resize an image)

**Composite.** `Composite` (Blend two images together)
## A project's own nodes

Not listed here, because they belong to the project rather than to Cascade. Ask
the running server: `GET /api/nodes` returns each module with its `runsOn` and
icon, and `GET /api/nodes/<name>/index.ts` returns its source.
